card.name: Words of tribute, blessing and dedication
card.fires_on: Small words in ceremonial or dedicatory phrases, such as 'to' after 'We ask Allah', 'those' after 'remembrance for', 'best' in 'wish ... all the best', and '-Semitism' after 'anti'. The setting is web text about honoring, thanking, praying or opposing prejudice.

modes.label: Tribute and good wishes
modes.description: A linking word or 'best' inside phrases that honor, dedicate, congratulate or pray for people.
modes.example: Memorial Day, originally called Decoration Day, is a day of remembrance for<< those>> who have died in our nation’s service

modes.label: Anti- prejudice terms
modes.description: The hyphenated word after 'anti' in statements condemning prejudice.
modes.example: The fight against anti<<-Semitism>> must be our fight.

card.plain: It lights up on small words in phrases of honor, thanks, prayer or dedication, and on 'anti-Semitism' in statements against prejudice.
